about: A test board for the pipeline (mv make). Not a video for J. Times follow cards.map.json at 30 fps.

shots.action: He sits alone on the sofa, the TV on, nothing else moving.
shots.change: The place and the man: alone with a TV.

shots.action: His face, lit by the TV. Nothing on it reaches him.
The door opens behind him; a woman stands in it.
She walks in past him and stops by the TV, looking at him.
shots.change: She owns the room; he still does not look up.

shots.action: Over his shoulder: she looks down at him.
Over her shoulder: he finally looks up at her.
The two of them in the room, saying nothing.
shots.change: They share the room and nothing else.

shots.action: She stands by the TV, unmoving, owning the room.
shots.change: She has won without a word.

shots.action: From above: he is small on the sofa, she is gone from frame.
Outside, the street. She takes one breath.
She walks away down the street.
She stops under the lamp and looks back once.
shots.change: A last look: she is not sure either.
